blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday called for a reasonable increase in hazard pay for personnel of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and Bureau of Corrections (BuCor). Citing the “tight” fiscal space for 2027, Lacson warned that granting the NBI’s proposed pay hike could prompt similar demands from other law enforcement agencies. During the Senate plenary deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Justice (DOJ), Lacson questioned the NBI’s request to increase the monthly hazard pay of qualified personnel from P4,000 to P15,000. “I’m not against giving hazard pay to NBI agents kasi alam […]...
